_comment: Per-customer suite catalog. Copy to 'sovrana-connect.json' and place NEXT TO the installed SovranaConnect executable (same folder). No rebuild needed. Adding a Sovrana tool = adding one object to 'services'. If the file is absent the app uses its baked defaults. With exactly one service the app skips the launcher and opens it full-screen. A v1 file with a bare 'endpoint' field still works. Phase 1 = plain HTTP on the LAN.
title: SovranaConnect
